about_the_game:
Build a party to crawl through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting with a hint of cosmic horror. Equip items, position, and level up your party in a strategic manner to maximize their power and defeat waves of enemies until you face the final boss!

Your decisions on what to buy and how to arrange your party will have a huge impact on the success or failure of your run! Think carefully before you send them out to battle.

This demo features two initial levels of the full game with several additional challenge modes attached to those levels.

Your party will auto-battle through their own unique deck of cards, which can be added or removed depending on what you buy.

  • Each unit has its own deck of ability cards that determine the flow of battle. Mix and match with items to create an unstoppable force. 

  • Pick from Fates, which have symmetrical battle effects, that make every crawl a unique experience. Choose wisely to take advantage of your strengths while minimizing the enemy's weaknesses.

  • Scale your rewards and your difficulty with Stress levels which add unique enemy modifiers. Take it easy or push your limits, it's your choice.

Each unit has an extensive skill tree that allows you to customize and expand their roles in battle. Do you optimize your Blade Runner for damage output or for its evasiveness?

  • Unlock and pick from a large variety of unique classes (8 classes in the demo), each with its own signature skills, skill trees, and specialized ability cards.

  • Gain experience to unlock each unit's skill tree to increase your party's power (Units can be leveled to 5 in the demo).

Create the ultimate party and see how your plan plays out as you duke it out with dozens of enemy combatants with their own special skills and abilities! Then do it again because it's just "one more run"!

name: Neon Auto Party Demo
short_description: Craft and configure your party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its own deck of cards that determines their performance in battle. Take advantage of powerful synergies between units, items and abilities and reach the end of the dangerous zones!
